reviewContext.userProblem: AgentGatewayAppCore transcription failures are flattened into GatewayRPCError(-32010, "vendor HTTP <status>: <first 500 bytes>"). This drops Retry-After, drops vendor codes beyond 500 bytes, and gives no classification. Transport errors pass through raw, and the default URLSession silently follows 3xx redirects, which sends a second wire request. Callers such as Riela's speech-to-text node cannot classify failures.
requiredOutcomes: Public GatewayTranscriptionFailure (Error, Sendable, Equatable, LocalizedError) with vendor, classification, httpStatus, retryAfterSeconds, vendorErrorType, vendorErrorCode, vendorMessage, rawBody (<= 16,384 UTF-8 bytes) and message; Classification has quotaExhausted, rateLimited, serverError, authFailed, invalidRequest, transport and unknown.
Every failure after the transport is called, except cancellation, throws GatewayTranscriptionFailure; rpcError maps to GatewayRPCError(-32010, message).
Retry-After is parsed from delta-seconds or an IMF-fixdate HTTP-date.
Exactly one wire request per transcribe call: a per-call redirect-refusing delegate, a 3xx reported with its status, and no internal retries.
The CLI prints the six-line structured stderr and exits 1 on GatewayTranscriptionFailure.
The README documents the failure contract.
mise run build, mise run test and mise run lint pass.
nonGoals: No change to the success path, GatewayTranscriptionParams, GatewayTranscriptionResult, GatewayTranscribing, or the public ProductionGatewayExecutor.transcribe signature.
No parsing of body retry hints (Gemini RetryInfo), and no RFC 850 or asctime HTTP-date forms.
No changes to GatewayRPCError, GatewayProtocol.swift, Package.swift, or files unrelated to transcription.
constraints: Source compatibility: checks before the transport keep throwing GatewayRPCError (-32021, -32602, -32011) or Foundation file errors; CancellationError keeps priority.
Never include API keys, Authorization headers, request URLs or String(describing: error) in failures, logs or test output; redact the secret before truncating.
Swift files stay under 1000 lines; swiftlint reports 0 violations; follow AGENTS.md and the Swift coding skill.
Each plan uses an isolated SwiftPM scratch path and logs under its artifact root.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Throw GatewayTranscriptionFailure directly and keep -32010 reachable through rpcError and errorDescription.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: GatewayRPCError is a Codable wire struct in the AgentGateway module and has no payload field, so it cannot carry the structured failure.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Classification order: vendor type/code first, then HTTP status.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: OpenAI sends insufficient_quota on a 429, so vendor codes must win to separate quota exhaustion from rate limiting.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Gemini RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED is classified as rateLimited.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Gemini uses it for both per-minute and per-day quotas; the message text is not reliable. Callers can inspect vendorMessage.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 3xx is classified as unknown with the status kept; 403 is authFailed.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The required enum has no redirect case.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Redact the full body before truncating (DF-001).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Cutting first could leave a partial key prefix at the boundary. Secret removal takes precedence over keeping the legacy message byte-identical.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A per-call redirect-refusing delegate that records the 3xx response, proven by a loopback regression test with a mutation check (DF-002).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Stub transports replace the very component that decides whether a redirect is followed, so only a real URLSession test proves one wire request.

intentionalTradeoffs: The thrown type changes for vendor and transport failures. Callers that caught GatewayRPCError must add a catch for GatewayTranscriptionFailure; the README documents this.
When the body echoes the key, the legacy -32010 message text differs from before because of [REDACTED].
The loopback plan temporarily mutates GatewayTranscription.swift and must restore it byte-identical, verified by sha256.
Plan artifacts and logs use tmp/transcription-failure-build/<planId>, as declared in the accepted plans; workflow-level evidence uses evidenceRoot.
supportedEdgeCases: OpenAI 429 insufficient_quota/credit_balance_exhausted -> quotaExhausted with the code preserved.
302 -> failure with httpStatus 302, the redirect not followed, exactly one request.
A body longer than 500 bytes (up to 20,000 bytes) still yields the vendor code; rawBody is capped at 16,384 bytes.
Transport URLError -> transport; CancellationError is rethrown unchanged.
Non-HTTP response, 2xx invalid JSON or invalid payload -> unknown.
Gemini and OpenRouter error shapes; the Gemini key in the URL never leaks.
The secret placed at the 500-byte and 16,384-byte truncation boundaries is redacted.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Obsolete RFC 850 and asctime Retry-After formats.
Runtime verification of the Linux FoundationNetworking redirect delegate (compile-checked only).

acceptanceCriteria: The public GatewayTranscriptionFailure, Classification, init, rpcError and errorDescription match the pinned contract exactly.
Internal helpers (redaction, UTF-8 prefix, Retry-After parser, vendor body parser, classifier) and the httpFailure/responseFailure/transportFailure factories exist with the pinned signatures.
Redaction is applied to the full body before the 500-byte and 16,384-byte prefixes are taken.
All the listed Retry-After, classification, body parser, factory and redaction tests pass; the existing transcription tests still pass; swiftlint reports 0 violations.

README ## Audio transcription documents items 1-9: failure sources, fields, classification, Retry-After, one request, rpcError compatibility, secrets, the six-line CLI stderr with exit 1, and a Swift catch snippet.
Nothing outside ## Audio transcription changes; no emojis; README hashes are recorded.
verification: grep -n "^## Audio transcription\|^## Provider routing library\|^### Failure contract" README.md

acceptanceCriteria: Every failure after the transport is called, except cancellation, is a GatewayTranscriptionFailure; failures before the transport are unchanged.
The production transport refuses redirects with a per-call GatewayTranscriptionRedirectRefusal delegate and returns the recorded 3xx response when data(for:) throws.

Stub pipeline cases 1-13 pass, including exactly one request per call (also for 302), 429 quota/rate-limit with Retry-After 7, 503, 401, a body longer than 500 bytes, transport, and secret-boundary redaction.
The two updated legacy tests pass and all other transcription tests pass unchanged; no new public symbols; build, test and lint exit 0.

GatewayTranscriptionFailure is caught first in runTranscription and rendered as the exact six-line stderr (message, classification, http-status, vendor-error-type, vendor-error-code, retry-after-seconds; nil prints as none), with exit 1 and empty stdout.
The structuredQuotaFailure, structuredTransportFailure and secretBoundaryInStderr tests pass; the existing TranscribeCommandTests, including httpErrors, pass unchanged.

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Temporary one-line mutation that removes the delegate from URLSession(...) to prove the loopback test fails, then a manual revert. The sha256 must be byte-identical before and after. There is no net change.

acceptanceCriteria: The loopback test passes with the production transport: one request to /v1/audio/transcriptions, zero to /redirected, httpStatus 302, classification unknown, and the key absent from String(describing: failure).

The mutation check proves detection: a non-zero exit, 'redirect was followed' (or a failed /redirected count) in logs/mutation.log, no ' error: ' compiler lines, and cli-owned file hashes recorded; an inconclusive result is reported as a blocked check.
GatewayTranscription.swift is restored byte-identical (sha256 match) and test-after-restore.log shows exit=0 with 1 test passed.
Build, test, regression and lint exit 0.
